title: Ren the Summoner and the Erotic Dungeon

patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the patch archive onto your computer Run "summoner_ren_patch_v2.exe" and select your Steam game install folder (from Step 1) when asked to Select Destination Location It's working if: The main menu has a background image instead of just a plain colour, and when choosing a difficulty there are images to accompany the options. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
